title: Determinant Dynamics under Low-Rank Perturbations: A Unified Framework for Singular Systems
summary: This paper develops a unified analytical framework for determinant identities under finite-rank perturbations of square matrices that remains valid without invertibility assumptions. In contrast to classical inverse-based formulations, the approach is based on an adjugate-driven additive representation, which extends naturally to singular matrices and yields explicit, non-asymptotic formulas.
